description: 2SK184-GR low-noise N-channel JFET, GR grade (the Boss BD-2's; our model from Toshiba's sheet)

source.licence: Our own model built from the maker's data sheet (D-159, D-161): the values are Solum Builder's

package.name: TO-92 mini (Toshiba 2-4E1C)
package.source: Toshiba 2SK184 data sheet (2007-11-01), page 1: 1. Drain 2. Gate 3. Source

fit.figure: |Yfs| - IDSS, ID - VGS and ID - VDS (typical, page 2)
fit.method: Idss the geometric middle of the GR grade's 2.6-6.5 mA (4.11 mA). Vp -0.482 V from the typical |Yfs|-IDSS figure (17.1 mS at that Idss) by the square law, Vp = -2·Idss/|Yfs|, as the 2SK209-GR (D-216): the sheet's tables and figures are the 2SK209's, its |Yfs| line within 1 % of that one's. The VGS(OFF)-IDSS figure is read at 0.1 µA, in the tail a square law doesn't follow, so it isn't used. BETA = Idss/Vp². LAMBDA 0.006 as the 2SK209-GR's: the 2SK184's ID-VDS figure (low voltage region, VGS = 0) is as flat as that one's at the figure's resolution. CGD = Crss 3 pF, CGS = Ciss − Crss = 10 pF (typical).
fit.note: Real units spread over the grade's range; a circuit's measured Idss and Vp replace these (D-130)

datasheet.source: Toshiba 2SK184 data sheet (2007-11-01), Electrical Characteristics: IDSS at VDS = 10 V, GR 2.6~6.5 mA
